5. Final Clinical Outcome: The Doctor arrived at a diagnosis of COPD, which aligns with the clinical evidence provided (chronic cough, clear sputum, hyperinflation on X-ray, no infiltrates). The diagnosis was medically sound and supported by the gathered evidence.
